name: India
intro: Unlock a land of profound heritage, architectural marvels, and cooperative community enterprise. From the historical lanes of Old Delhi to the backwater lagoons of Kerala, India is a majestic cultural epic.
bestSeason: October to March (Cool and dry season across most regions)
weather: Varies by region. Tropical monsoon in the south, seasonal subtropical in the north. Comfortable dry winter months (12°C to 26°C) are ideal for sightseeing.
language: Hindi, English, regional languages (Marathi, Malayalam, Rajasthani)
visaInfo: Indian tourist e-Visa required for international passport holders prior to arrival.
flightDuration: Domestic travel or short direct flights between hubs.
highlights: Witness the industrial drive and sorting systems in Mumbai Dharavi
Gaze at the Taj Mahal dome reflecting the morning sunrise in Agra
Cruise the quiet palm-fringed backwaters of Kerala on a solar houseboat
Sleep in community-run heritage Haveli hotels in Old Delhi and Jaipur

famousPlaces.name: Mumbai Dharavi & Local Communities
famousPlaces.shortDesc: An educational walking tour highlighting the light recycling industries and local potter communities of Dharavi.
famousPlaces.overview: Mumbai is the commercial capital of India. Dharavi, nestled in its center, is home to thousands of community light industries. Our walks focus on sorting recycling workshops, clay potter guilds, and cooperative family spaces.

hotels.name: Colaba Heritage Boutique Inn
hotels.description: Eco-friendly, community-conscious inn in South Mumbai supporting local staff.

famousPlaces.meals: Traditional home-cooked vegetarian dinner with a local family included.
famousPlaces.transport: Mumbai local train transit passes and taxicabs.
famousPlaces.activities: Dharavi Recycling Walk, Kumbharwada Pottery Studio Session, Dhobi Ghat Visit.
included: Contributions to Reality Gives NGO schools

faqs.a: To respect the privacy and dignity of local residents. Our walks are purely educational.

reviews.author: Marie L.
reviews.text: An eye-opening walk. The resourcefulness and recycling operations are highly inspiring.

itinerary.title: Recycling Workshops & Family Dinner
itinerary.morning: Meet guide, ride local train to see Dhobi Ghat laundry yard.
itinerary.afternoon: Guided walk through Dharavi's sorting workshops and Kumbharwada potter lanes.
itinerary.evening: Sit down for dinner with a host family in the pottery community.

famousPlaces.name: Delhi Sanjay Colony Walk
famousPlaces.shortDesc: Explore the fabric sorting and textile recycling units in Sanjay Colony, South Delhi.
famousPlaces.overview: Sanjay Colony is an industrious enclave in South Delhi. This walking tour guides you through its manufacturing workshops, showing how garments are collected, sorted, shredded, and recycled.

hotels.name: Haveli Dharampura Old Delhi
hotels.description: UNESCO Award-winning restored heritage haveli inside Chandni Chowk.

famousPlaces.transport: Delhi Metro transit support and cycle rickshaws.
famousPlaces.activities: Textile Recycling Walk, Local Temple Walk, Reality Gives Classroom Visit.
included: Donation to local computer learning center

faqs.a: We meet outside the Harkesh Nagar Okhla Metro Station entrance.

reviews.author: James P.
reviews.text: Fascinating look at garment sorting. Great to see my ticket supports a classroom inside the colony.

itinerary.title: Textile Mills & Community Classrooms
itinerary.morning: Meet at Metro, enter Sanjay Colony to view sorting units.
itinerary.afternoon: Stroll past neighborhood homes and local Hindu temples.
itinerary.evening: Visit the local youth training school funded by your tour.

famousPlaces.name: Rajasthan Village Heritage
famousPlaces.shortDesc: Discover Jaipur's historic forts, craft cooperatives, and desert village homestays.
famousPlaces.overview: Rajasthan is a land of architectural marvels. This multi-day journey goes beyond historic fortresses to support desert artisan cooperatives and Groundwater conservation projects.

hotels.name: Jaipur Heritage Haveli
hotels.description: Converted royal town mansion with beautiful carved stone arches.

famousPlaces.meals: Traditional Rajasthani dinners prepared over wood fires.
famousPlaces.transport: Private AC sedan with experienced local driver guide.
famousPlaces.activities: Amber Fort History Tour, Hand-block Printing Workshop, Village Cooking Class.

faqs.q: Is travel to the desert bumpy?
faqs.a: We use clean, modern air-conditioned sedans or SUVs to ensure complete comfort along the highways.

reviews.author: Marcus H.
reviews.text: The village homestay was the highlight. Cooking dinner over the clay stove was incredible.

itinerary.title: Amber Fort & Block Print Masters
itinerary.morning: Guided history walk around Amber Fort's mirrored chambers.
itinerary.afternoon: Hands-on session with block-printing textile master craftsmen.
itinerary.evening: Folk music dining session at the Haveli courtyard.

itinerary.title: Road Trip to Desert Community
itinerary.morning: Drive towards Jodhpur rural village sectors.
itinerary.afternoon: Check into community homestay and meet the host family.
itinerary.evening: Cook a traditional dinner over clay stoves under the desert stars.

famousPlaces.name: Kerala Eco-Houseboat
famousPlaces.shortDesc: Cruise the backwaters of Alleppey on a traditional solar-powered eco-houseboat.
famousPlaces.overview: Relax in the calm backwaters of South India. Enjoy solar-powered houseboat cruises, dine on fresh organic farm produce, and tour organic spice plantations.

hotels.name: Alleppey Lagoon Eco-Cottages
hotels.description: Lakeside cottages built using sustainable local thatch and bamboo.

famousPlaces.meals: Fresh organic farm dinners and Keralan fish dishes.
famousPlaces.transport: Solar Houseboat cruise and eco-sedan airport transfers.
famousPlaces.activities: Backwater Canal Canoe Trip, Organic Spice Farm Walk, Kathakali Dance Show.
included: Organic meals prepared by onboard chef

faqs.a: It runs fully on solar power for lights and fans, utilizes advanced waste-filtration units, and employs local rowers.

reviews.author: Alice R.
reviews.text: Drifting down the palm-fringed canals on the solar houseboat was pure peace. The food was delicious.

itinerary.title: Chinese Fishing Nets & Kathakali
itinerary.morning: Arrive in Cochin, walk past Fort Kochi's historic shorelines.
itinerary.afternoon: Transfer to lagoon cottages and check in.
itinerary.evening: Watch a classical Kathakali dance session at the village center.

itinerary.title: Boarding the Solar Houseboat
itinerary.morning: Board your private solar-powered eco-houseboat at the jetty.
itinerary.afternoon: Slow cruise through shallow backwater canals observing village life.
itinerary.evening: Enjoy dinner prepared by your onboard private chef.

famousPlaces.name: Old Delhi Spice Crawl
famousPlaces.shortDesc: Explore Chandni Chowk spice markets and sample safe, vetted local street foods.
famousPlaces.overview: Old Delhi is a sensory experience. Ride cycle rickshaws through historic spice alleys, visit ancient shrines, and sample hygienic local street recipes.

hotels.name: Haveli Dharampura
hotels.description: Award-winning restored Mughal haveli inside old city gates.

famousPlaces.meals: Traditional street food tastings and sunset rooftop chai.
famousPlaces.activities: Spice Market Rickshaw Ride, Vetted Street Food Tasting, Jama Masjid Sunset View.
included: All food samples at vetted hygienic stalls

faqs.a: Yes. We only visit specific stalls vetted for filtered water usage and clean ingredient preparation.

reviews.author: Thomas K.
reviews.text: Our guide was fantastic. We tasted incredible samosas and jalebis completely worry-free.

itinerary.title: Bazaars & Domes of Shahjahanabad
itinerary.morning: Meet at Metro, ride rickshaw into Khari Baoli spice bazaar.
itinerary.afternoon: Walk historical paths sampling fresh street treats.
itinerary.evening: Watch the sunset from the steps of the giant Jama Masjid mosque.

famousPlaces.name: Agra Heritage & Taj Mahal Sunrise
famousPlaces.shortDesc: See the Taj Mahal at dawn, explore Agra Fort, and meet heritage stone artisans.
famousPlaces.overview: Experience the world's monument to love at sunrise. Visit the sandstone palaces of Agra Fort and support local stone inlay craft guilds in their workshops.

hotels.name: Agra Heritage Inn
hotels.description: Charming boutique hotel close to the eastern gate of the Taj Mahal.

famousPlaces.meals: Traditional breakfasts and Mughal-style local dinners.
famousPlaces.transport: Private AC sedan and local rickshaws.
famousPlaces.activities: Taj Mahal Sunrise Entry, Agra Fort Walk, Stone Inlay Artisan Workshop Tour.
included: Sunrise entry ticket to Taj Mahal
Agra Fort entry ticket and private guide

faqs.q: What can I carry inside the Taj Mahal?
faqs.a: Only small bags with wallets, phones, and water bottles are allowed. Large bags, tripods, chargers, and food are prohibited.

reviews.author: Alice R.
reviews.text: Stunning morning light at the Taj. The guide knew exactly the best spots to capture photographs.

itinerary.title: Agra Fort & Pietra Dura Crafts
itinerary.morning: Chauffeur drive to Agra. Check into hotel.
itinerary.afternoon: Tour the massive red sandstone walls of Agra Fort.
itinerary.evening: Meet local craftsmen displaying Pietra Dura marble stone inlay work.

itinerary.title: Taj Mahal Sunrise & Departure
itinerary.morning: Sunrise tour of the Taj Mahal as dawn light reflects on the white marble dome.
itinerary.afternoon: Gourmet hotel breakfast, check out and return drive.
